title: Made possible by the community
mission: This launcher is for people who just want to play, without having to understand command lines, engine builds or compatibility fixes.
credit: Years of work by engine developers, mod teams and open-source maintainers make these games work on modern systems. C&C Unix Launcher brings their work together and guides you through setup. The engines, mods and compatibility tools belong to their creators.
tooltip: Years of community work make this possible. This launcher makes setup easier for everyday players. Also consider donating directly to the projects and maintainers behind it; their support links are in Community & support.
